lines.x: Intesa Sanpaolo posted third-quarter 2026 profits exceeding 8.2 billion euros, according to an earnings call transcript.

The FAO raised its global cereal production forecast to 2.999 billion metric tons, with global cereal stocks expected to increase by 17.2 million tons, largely driven by higher wheat inventories in Russia.
Intesa Sanpaolo is planning a late November launch for its €33 billion takeover bid for Banca Monte dei Paschi di Siena.
Stellantis has extended the production stoppage for the Fiat 500 model by an additional week.
